headline: Hazelnuts: production +10% but drought and pests weigh, price uncertainty - Typical Products - Ansa.it
summary: The 2026 Italian hazelnut harvest is estimated at about 750,000 quintals, with production up 10%. Drought and pests are weighing on the crop and price outlook.
why: Hazelnuts are a globally traded agricultural commodity, with Italy a major producer used by confectionery makers. Crop size and drought conditions drive price expectations.
